actions.release_notes:
## What's Changed

### Enhancements
* Migrate to ESM and upgrade dependencies by @priyagupta108 in https://github.com/actions/setup-python/pull/1330
* Pin SHA commits and update docs with latest versions by @HarithaVattikuti in https://github.com/actions/setup-python/pull/1338
* Remove the pip-install input by @gowridurgad in https://github.com/actions/setup-python/pull/1336

### Bug Fix
* Fix to Classify stderr warning messages as warnings instead of errors in annotations by @lmvysakh in https://github.com/actions/setup-python/pull/1335
* Validate and retry manifest fetch to prevent silent failures by @priyagupta108 in https://github.com/actions/setup-python/pull/1332

### Dependency Upgrade
* Bump certifi from 2020.6.20 to 2024.7.4 in /__tests__/data by @dependabot in https://github.com/actions/setup-python/pull/1328
* Remove EOL Python versions and Bumps numpy text fixture by @priya-kinthali in https://github.com/actions/setup-python/pull/1333
* Upgrade @actions/cache to 6.2.0 by @philip-gai in https://github.com/actions/setup-python/pull/1337

## New Contributors
* @lmvysakh made their first contribution in https://github.com/actions/setup-python/pull/1335
* @philip-gai made their first contribution in https://github.com/actions/setup-python/pull/1337

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/actions/setup-python/compare/v6...v7.0.0
